title: refactor(ci): modernize release automation, unify lint/test workflows, bump actions & deps
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Simplify and modernize our GitHub Actions workflows for lint/test/release automation and reduce maintenance overhead. Over time we've accumulated many duplicated workflows across repo roots and packages. This PR consolidates lint/test flows into a composable matrix, upgrades core actions (checkout, setup-node, cache) and Node versions to LTS-20, and replaces several deprecated actions. It also centralizes release automation: we move to a single release workflow that supports both manual and scheduled semantic releases with release-drafter integration, cleans up tagging logic, and adds improved artifact retention and promotion steps.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate lint/test workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml (matrix jobs for node/test-matrix)
- [x] Replace legacy release GH Action with semantic-release/rotations + release-drafter drafts
- [x] Bump setup-node/cache actions and use node 20 LTS in build matrix
- [x] Improve caching strategy: restore-key fallbacks, cache per-package lockfile hash
- [x] Reduce matrix size by splitting slow integration tests into separate pipeline that runs on nightly/PR-from-main only
- [x] Add explicit job timeouts and retry semantics for flaky network steps
- [x] Add migration notes for infra and ops teams

Summary of changes:
- New combined CI workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml that consolidates linters, unit tests, type checks, and integration test triggers.
- New release workflow at .github/workflows/release.yml with manual_dispatch, schedule, and conditional semantic-release when commits include [release].
- Removed >10 obsolete workflow files and a handful of small per-repo GH action snippets in favor of centralized, reusable workflow templates in .github/workflows/templates/.
- Updated .github/actions versions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v2.
- Added explicit lockfile-hash caching keys for pnpm/yarn/npm to reduce cross-job cache misses.
- Split slow integration tests into nightly-only workflow and added test tagging for local runners.

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the release gating logic and caching keys — those are easy to get wrong and can cause missed builds or stale caches. The lint/type/test steps are intentionally conservative (no test parallelization tuning in this PR) to avoid introducing flakiness during rollout.

Related: ENG-2145 (CI unification), ENG-2190 (release automation hygiene).

review_comments: Miguel Santos: Looks good overall — can you confirm that the release workflow will still create a GitHub Release when semantic-release publishes? I want to ensure org tooling picks up the tag.
Asha Patel: Yes — semantic-release is configured to create GH releases and release-drafter will seed the draft prior to publish. See tools/release/semantic-release-config.js for the plugin list.
Priya Desai: Can we add a guard to prevent semantic-release on forks or dependabot PRs? We had accidental releases before.
Asha Patel: Added a check to the workflow to skip semantic-release unless actor is in the allowed list or the event is push to main with [release] in the commit message.
Jordan Lee: Lint job failed in CI with a test snapshot mismatch — please update the snapshot or pin the new dependency.
Asha Patel: Fixed the snapshot and added a changelog entry explaining the minor test fixture update.
Connor O'Neill: Cache keys look solid. I tested re-run behavior and live cache restores work as expected. Approved after small nit on timeout settings.
Miguel Santos: Approved — thanks for the careful migration notes for infra/ops.

changelog_entry: chore(ci): modernize workflows, bump actions, centralize release automation
notes_for_ops:
See docs/ci-migration.md for migration steps. After merge:
1) Ensure organization runner policies allow node 20 or update runner labels.
2) Verify secrets used by semantic-release (NPM_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN) are present in repo or org.
3) If you rely on per-repo workflow files, update any external tooling to point at the new templates under .github/workflows/templates/.
qa_steps:
1) Open a small PR that changes a README to verify CI path for lint/type/test.
2) Create a release branch with [release] in commit message on main and run release workflow in dry-run.
3) Trigger nightly integration run and confirm artifacts are produced and stored with correct retention.
